key.name: llm-provider
key.description: A pi provider id, e.g. mistral, openai, anthropic; empty uses the config file's llm.provider, else mistral.

key.name: llm-model
key.description: The provider's model id; empty uses the config file's llm.model.

key.name: llm-base-url
key.description: Base URL for the chat model, e.g. an OpenAI-compatible server; empty uses the config file's llm.server for the config's provider, else the provider's default.

key.name: speech-base-url
key.description: Mistral API base URL for transcription, voices and web search.

key.name: stt-model
key.description: Empty uses the config file's stt.model.

key.name: tts-model
key.description: Empty uses the config file's tts.model.

key.name: voice-ro
key.description: Voice id for Romanian replies; empty uses the config file's, else the API's default.

key.name: voice-en
key.description: Voice id for English replies; empty uses the config file's, else the API's default.
